fusions.name: Ankle Nick
fusions.desc: A low chop at the legs that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Wainscot
fusions.desc: A darting chop on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Scurrying Edges
fusions.desc: Looses a scurrying swarm of tiny blades for 10 seconds that strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each strike with a 25% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nibbled Down
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
